title: Condition Share of the Marketplace Orders Replacement Charge
content:
**Schedule.** The condition share of the Marketplace Orders replacement charge follows the reason the replacement was shipped for: a replacement for a defective unit charges the defective-unit share of 0.8 (80%) of the item price, since the kept original does not work; a replacement for a unit damaged in transit charges the transit-damage share of 0.7 (70%); a replacement for any other reason charges the whole item price.

The charged item amount of the replacement charge is the item price of the replaced units times that share, rounded half up to the cent, and the sales tax of the replacement charge is worked out on the charged item amount in place of the item price.

## Share by reason

The reason is the reason recorded on the replacement entry of the order.

| Replacement shipped for | Share of the item price charged |
|---|---|
| defective | 80% |
| damaged in transit | 70% |
| any other reason (for example wrong item) | 100% |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Order of 2 units at USD 45.00, shipping charge USD 0.00, sales tax USD 7.20; 1 unit replaced.

| Reason on the replacement entry | Charged item amount | Sales tax on it |
|---|---|---|
| defective | 45.00 times 0.8, that is 36.00 | 7.20 times 36.00 divided by 90.00, that is 2.88 |
| damaged in transit | 45.00 times 0.7, that is 31.50 | 7.20 times 31.50 divided by 90.00, that is 2.52 |
| wrong item | 45.00 | 3.60 |
